name: 幸运抽奖
description: 输入一串候选名单，随机抽出获奖者；支持设置中奖人数、允许重复中奖。适合群抽奖、点名、随机分组。

config.code:
import random
from datetime import datetime

MEDALS = ["\U0001F3C6", "\U0001F948", "\U0001F949"]

def run(args):
    options = args.get("options") or []
    if isinstance(options, str):
        options = [x.strip() for x in options.replace("\uff0c", ",").split(",") if x.strip()]
    options = [str(o) for o in options if str(o).strip()]
    if not options:
        raise ValueError("\u5019\u9009\u540d\u5355\u4e0d\u80fd\u4e3a\u7a7a")

    count = int(args.get("count") or 1)
    allow_repeat = bool(args.get("allow_repeat") or False)
    count = max(1, min(count, 99 if allow_repeat else len(options)))

    if allow_repeat:
        winners = [random.choice(options) for _ in range(count)]
    else:
        winners = random.sample(options, count)

    decorated = []
    for i, name in enumerate(winners):
        medal = MEDALS[i] if i < len(MEDALS) else "\U0001F389"
        decorated.append({"\u540d\u6b21": i + 1, "\u4eba\u9009": name, "\u5f69\u5e26": medal})

    return {
        "winners": decorated,
        "\u5019\u9009\u603b\u6570": len(options),
        "\u62bd\u53d6\u6570\u91cf": len(winners),
        "\u62bd\u7b7e\u65f6\u95f4": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "\u795d\u8bed": "\u606d\u559c\u4ee5\u4e0a\u5e78\u8fd0\u513f\uff01\U0001F38A"
    }

params.name: options
params.description: 候选名单，数组或逗号分隔字符串

params.name: allow_repeat
params.description: 是否允许同一人重复中奖
